lines.native: Ciao! Come stai? A riddle: what can wait until—oh, a leaf. Just one more minute. Hai tempo?
lines.translation: Hi! How are you? A riddle: what can wait until—oh, a leaf. Just one more minute. Do you have time?
lines.narrative: The cracked fountain drips with the confidence of a public service doing its best. Flick flickers at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker pops where he isn't.

lines.native: Guarda? Sì, guardo! Oh, una foglia! You got me looking, not stopping. Attention span: leaf out of ten. Vuoi che io resti qui? Give me a command to stop—before that leaf gets interesting.
lines.translation: Look? Yes, I’m looking! Oh, a leaf! You got me looking, not stopping. Attention span: leaf out of ten. Do you want me to stay here? Give me a command to stop—before that leaf gets interesting.
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops at the edge of your vision. Flick looks at the leaf. This has not improved the situation.

lines.native: Mi fermo! Va bene, sono qui. A riddle: where do we go when—oh, a moth. Dove andiamo? Quale direzione? Your attention span gets a bonus. Collect it tomorrow.
lines.translation: I’m stopping! All right, I’m here. A riddle: where do we go when—oh, a moth. Where are we going? Which direction? Your attention span gets a bonus. Collect it tomorrow.
lines.narrative: Flick stops at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker lands nearby, apparently to commemorate this administrative breakthrough.

lines.native: Left? In inglese! Capisco, ma serve una direzione in italiano. Dove vado? A riddle: which way is—oh, that moth again. Just one more minute.
lines.translation: Left? In English! I understand, but a direction in Italian is needed. Where do I go? A riddle: which way is—oh, that moth again. Just one more minute.
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains at the edge of your vision, where responsibility has difficulty focusing.

lines.native: A sinistra! Sì, va bene! Ma partiamo domani? Sono stanco. A riddle: what comes after—oh, another moth. Just five more minutes. Aspettiamo?
lines.translation: To the left! Yes, all right! But shall we leave tomorrow? I'm tired. A riddle: what comes after—oh, another moth. Just five more minutes. Shall we wait?
lines.narrative: Flick darts left, remaining at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker announces that further progress has been postponed for administrative reasons.

lines.native: Domani? Sì! Mi piace! Ma domani non va bene per te: vuoi partire subito, vero? A riddle: when is the best time to—oh, dust. Just five more minutes?
lines.translation: Tomorrow? Yes! I like it! But tomorrow doesn't work for you: you want to leave immediately, right? A riddle: when is the best time to—oh, dust. Just five more minutes?
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops at the edge of your vision. Flick has postponed departing, then postponed explaining why.

lines.native: No, adesso! Sì, hai ragione. Andiamo a sinistra, subito! Un indovinello: perché oggi—oh, una falena. Fine, you win. Just one more—no? Va bene, partiamo!
lines.translation: No, now! Yes, you're right. Let's go left, right away! A riddle: why today—oh, a moth. Fine, you win. Just one more—no? All right, let's go!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops at the edge of your vision. Flick reluctantly heads left. The present has finally secured an appointment.
